pairs.subject: spatial-audio-scene-authoring
pairs.evidence: src/lib/catalog/pipelines/ambient.ts:518 The ambient pipeline's occlusion presets (OCL_Outdoor_Open / OCL_Indoor_Ruined) carry only decibel attenuation values with no low-pass cutoff in the same row, which is the 'occlusion as a volume fade' failure the standard names; the attenuation and reverb steps also show their own gaps.

techniques.evidence: src/lib/catalog/pipelines/ambient.ts:518 Each occlusion level is a dB value only, with no paired cutoff in Hz. Obstruction and occlusion are kept separate (obstructionDb vs occlusionDb), and transitions crossfade over 400-800 ms, both of which are good. Per-emitter filtering is left to Wwise ('no manual curves needed'), but the authored preset table itself never carries a filter.

src/lib/catalog/pipelines/ambient.ts:321 The curve is logarithmic and units are stated (cm), which is good. But the shared ATT preset uses a constant inner radius of 150 cm against a 2000 cm max, about 7.5%, not a fraction of the zone radius. It has no distance low-pass sweep, so distance attenuation is volume-only.

src/lib/catalog/pipelines/ambient.ts:521 The presets REV_ExteriorSmall and REV_SmallRuin are named but resolve to no decay/diffusion/density/wet/early/late table anywhere in src; a grep finds only these two references. A tail length is also typed inline beside the preset name, which creates a second authority for it. Outdoor is not modelled as dry, which is good.

src/lib/catalog/pipelines/ambient.ts:310 Concurrency is one pool shared by all one-shot classes rather than a limit per class. Cooldowns exist as minimumRetriggerSec at line 434 (in seconds, not ms, but the unit is named). No class carries a priority band. Ducking of the ambient bed during combat is declared at line 706, but no choice between priority and ducking is recorded per class.

src/lib/catalog/pipelines/ambient.ts:287 The zone bed is positionless, and a rationale is given at lines 290-292. Detail loops and one-shots are positioned 3D mono on the source actors. The silence-beat stinger is 2D with spatialisation: null.
